source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    events = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            color = row[c - 1]
            if color and row[c] == 0 and row[c + 1] == color:
                out[r][c] = color
                events.setdefault(c, []).append((r, color))
    for c, marks in events.items():
        prev = -1
        for r, color in marks:
            for rr in range(prev + 1, r + 1):
                out[rr][c] = color
            prev = r
        lower = next((rr for rr in range(prev + 1, h) if grid[rr][c] != 0), None)
        if lower is not None:
            color = grid[lower][c]
            for rr in range(prev + 1, lower):
                out[rr][c] = color
